name: T3 Code server
description: Installs a pinned, hash-verified T3 Code server, starts it with the container, and lets a T3 Code client reach it over SSH through `docker exec`, so the dev container becomes a T3 Code environment without publishing any port.

version.description: T3 Code release to install. Only versions whose archive hash is pinned in this feature are accepted.

autostart.description: Start the server in the background whenever the container starts.

ssh.description: Install an SSH server that is only reachable through `docker exec` (no daemon, no port), for T3 Code's SSH connection mode. Makes the remote user's password empty.

host.description: Address the server listens on inside the container. Use 0.0.0.0 only when publishing the port instead of connecting over SSH.

strict.description: Fail the build when the image cannot run the feature. Set to false to skip the feature instead, for example when it is applied to every dev container through dev.containers.defaultFeatures.
